changes: Bound raster/texture work to stable panel animation bounds
Skia GPU rendering directly into an OpenGL GUI texture
Vulkan remains the game backend; private hidden OpenGL context draws Skia, transfers premultiplied panel RGBA for Vulkan composition
Preserve GL driver state and restore SDL context/capabilities
Route SDL window events by window ID so auxiliary resizes cannot resize the game
Move alpha diagnostics off normal frames

measurement_conditions.cpu_baseline: after bounded raster optimization, before GPU rendering; conservative comparison to the original full-window CPU raster

limits: Windows x64 real OpenGL and real Vulkan tested; Linux not run in this change
Hidden benchmark window and reduced view distance are not a modpack FPS claim
Vulkan Skia acceleration needs an auxiliary OpenGL 3.3 driver; raster remains the fallback if it cannot initialize
